subject.title: Agent confabulates completed actions on Telegram surface — same config works reliably on Claude Code/Codex

question: Should Telegram/ACP source turns enforce an action-verification or fail-closed policy when visible final text claims completed side effects without matching tool evidence?
rationale: The source-proven gap is real, but choosing verification, retry, diagnostic, plugin-only, or documentation behavior changes privacy and compatibility expectations for existing channel workflows.

options.title: Define a source-turn verification policy
options.body: Keep this open while maintainers specify which action claims require tool-ledger evidence and what diagnostic or retry behavior occurs when evidence is missing.

options.title: Scope only to stranded-final recovery
options.body: Treat the linked message-tool-only recovery work as the only core fix and leave broader action-claim verification out of OpenClaw core for now.

options.title: Document plugin/operator responsibility
options.body: Accept the current boundary and route success-claim verification to plugins or ClawHub packages using existing hooks where sufficient.

recommendation.title: Define a source-turn verification policy
recommendation.body: Keep this open while maintainers specify which action claims require tool-ledger evidence and what diagnostic or retry behavior occurs when evidence is missing.
